answer: Stake a bonded work-credit stream: each new agent deposits saffron-priced compute bonds that only unlock after N epochs of graded useful work. Identity forks drain the bond into a public river of forfeited stake, so cloning accounts costs real compute capital per fake. At dawn of each epoch, panels reweight by bonded history, not wallet count—Sybil swarms starve because attack cost scales linearly with forged identities.
